title: BRP Recalls Side-By-Side Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled vehicles can have a defective fuel hose assembly which could lead to a fuel leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,310 (In addition, about 320 were sold in Canada and about 34 were sold in Mexico).

title: Chamberlain Group Recalls LiftMaster myQ Garage Door Control Panels Due to Entrapment Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The control panel's secondary entrapment protection system can fail causing the garage door to close even with an obstruction present, posing an entrapment hazard. Units: About 96,400 (In addition, about 19,300 were sold in Canada).

title: English Riding Supply Recalls Ovation Protege Equestrian Helmets Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The recalled helmets fail to meet the impact requirements of the ASTM F1163-15 standard for this type of helmet, posing an impact injury hazard to riders who fall. Units: About 49,300 (In addition, about 5,270 were sold in Canada).

title: IKEA Recalls ODGER Swivel Chairs Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The chairs' leg base can break, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 12,000.

title: Skip Hop Recalls Silver Lining Cloud Activity Gyms Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The raindrops on the cloud toy included with the activity gym can detach from the ribbon, posing a choking hazard if a child places it in their mouth. Units: About 472,850 (In addition, about 23,280 were sold in Canada and about 2,240 were sold in Mexico).

title: 1st Stage Scuba Regulators Recalled Due to Risk of Injury and Drowning Hazard; Manufactured by XDEEP
summary: A defective screw on the turret connection can break, posing a risk of severe injury and drowning hazard for divers. Units: About 50 (In addition, about 10 were sold in Canada).

title: Clark Associates Recalls Lancaster Table & Seating Brand High Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The high chairs can break, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 22,400 (In addition, about 52 were sold in Canada).

title: Harbor Freight Tools USA Recalls Replacement Lower Blade Guards for 12-Inch Chicago Electric Miter Saw Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Harbor Freight Tools (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled replacement lower blade guards do not sufficiently cover the saw blade and can break when making a cut, posing an injury hazard to the user. Units: About 7,175.

title: More than 1.2 Million Mainstays Three-Wick Candles Recalled by Star Soap Star Candle Prayer Candle Due to Fire and Laceration Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The candle wicks can burn too close to the side of the container, causing the glass to break, posing fire and laceration hazards. Units: About 1,210,000.

title: Platinum Health Recalls LumaRail Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Serious Entrapment and Asphyxia Hazard; One Death Reported
summary: When the recalled bed rails are attached to an adult's bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress. This poses a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. Units: About 53,000.

title: Polaris Recalls Timbersled Snow Bike Conversion Kits Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The QuickDrive fastener can loosen while operating, leading to brake failure, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 780.

title: SCARPA North America Recalls F1 Ski Boots Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The two screws on each boot that attach the ski/walk mechanism to the cuff can loosen or fall out, causing the mechanism to malfunction, posing a fall hazard and risk of injury to the consumer. Units: About 770 (In addition, about 160 were sold in Canada).

title: TJX Recalls Bookcases Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Imported by Furniture Source International; Sold at HomeGoods
summary: The recalled bookcases are unstable and can tip over if not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 73.

title: Two Million COSORI® Air Fryers Recalled by Atekcity Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: A wire connection in the air fryers can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 2 million (In addition, about 250,000 were sold in Canada and about 21,000 were sold in Mexico).

title: Zinus Recalls SmartBase Euro Slats Metal Platform Bed Frames Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The bedframe assembly kit did not include reinforcing brackets for installation on the corners of the frame, which could lead to the frame collapsing, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 30,400.

summary: The arms or legs on the figurines can detach, posing a small part choking hazard to children. Units: About 16,140 (in addition, about 600 were sold in Canada).

title: KLIM Recalls Backcountry Probes Due to Risk of Severe Injury or Death
summary: The recalled probes can fail to operate when deployed by rescuers, posing a risk of severe injury or death to a person buried under snow following an avalanche. Units: About 3,930 (In addition, about 400 in Canada).

summary: Liquid propane (LP) gas can accumulate inside the closed lid and cabinets, causing an explosion when the user relights the grill, posing fire and burn hazards to the user. Units: About 18,000.
